title: An Introduction to Ethos, Logos and Pathos
skills: identify rhetorical appeals in written and spoken texts
analyze how appeals influence an audience
evaluate the effectiveness of persuasive strategies
alignment_note: Introduces the three classical rhetorical appeals—ethos, logos, and pathos—and explains how speakers and writers use credibility, logic, and emotion to influence audiences. Supports rhetorical analysis, argument evaluation, persuasive writing, and media literacy across high school English courses.
